name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After earning a degree in engineering, she initially worked in manufacturing, but a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked her interest. Her meticulous approach to problem-solving and natural leadership skills quickly made her an asset. She transitioned from a volunteer mechanic to a data analyst, honing her understanding of vehicle dynamics and performance. This eventually led her to Iron Dames where her experience in coordinating and analyzing test sessions is invaluable. 

As Test Driver Coordinator, Mei Lian thrives on ensuring that every test session is meticulously planned and executed. She's known for her ability to identify potential issues before they arise and for fostering a collaborative environment between the drivers, engineers, and mechanics. Her dedication to accuracy and clear communication makes her a highly effective leader. What sets Mei Lian apart is her ability to translate complex technical data into actionable insights, enabling the team to optimize car setup and driver performance.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with subtle layers
physical.description: Mei Lian has a warm, approachable face with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a lucky jade pendant she received from her grandmother.
Insists on using a specific type of pen for taking notes during test sessions.
Has a habit of humming softly when deeply focused on data analysis.
